name: Bearing Fit Advisor
blurb: shaft and housing tolerances for a bearing's bore and outside diameter
intro: Which ISO 286 tolerance class to put on the shaft and in the housing for a radial ball or roller bearing, and the interference or clearance it makes with the bearing's ISO 492 tolerances. The choice follows the SKF / NSK general tables: the ring that turns relative to the load gets the interference.

inputs.label: What turns relative to the load
options: Outer ring (hub turns on a fixed axle)

inputs.label: Stationary ring must slide axially (floating bearing)
Shaft class
inputs.help: Leave on Recommended, or pick a class to see the fit it makes.

inputs.label: Housing class
inputs.help: Leave on Recommended, or pick a class to see the fit it makes.

examples.title: 6204 on a motor shaft, normal load
6005 in a wheel hub on a fixed axle

usage: Give the bearing bore and outside diameter in mm, ball or roller, which ring turns relative to the load (inner, outer or indeterminate), the load class and housing type. It returns the shaft and housing tolerance classes, their limit sizes in mm, and the resulting interference / clearance range in µm, plus tables of neighbouring classes. Use it to put a bearing seat tolerance on a shaft or housing drawing.
sources: ISO 286-1 and ISO 286-2: limits and fits (IT grades, fundamental deviations)
ISO 492: radial bearings, tolerance class normal
SKF Rolling bearings catalogue, 'Selecting fits' tables (solid steel shafts, cast iron / steel housings)
